Container.Name: full-release
Container.Overview: Package a file or folder for upload to a private tracker: pulls metadata from Cove, builds a .torrent, a contact sheet, preview stills, and ready-to-paste BBCode. Web GUI.
Container.Description: Self-hosted helper that turns a local video file or folder into a tracker upload package. It queries your Cove instance for title/description/performers/tags, generates a private .torrent (with your tracker's announce URL and source flag), renders a contact sheet plus standalone preview stills, and fills a BBCode template. Images can be auto-uploaded (Chevereto/imgbb) or left as placeholders you swap after uploading to an approved host.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the web interface (container listens on 8080; 8080 was already taken on this server).

Config.Name: Config (appdata)
Config.Description: Persistent config. A starter config.yaml is written here on first run - edit it and restart.

Config.Name: Output
Config.Description: Where generated .torrent / contact sheet / bbcode files are written.

Config.Name: Media (read-write)
Config.Description: Your media library. READ-WRITE: single-file packaging moves the file into a release folder (name/file + name/screens/contact-sheet) on this share, and the torrent covers that folder. The file browser is restricted to this path.

Config.Name: Cove URL
Config.Description: Your Cove instance, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:5073 (use the LAN IP, not localhost). Overrides cove.url from config.yaml.

Config.Name: Cove Username
Config.Description: Cove login username (if Cove auth is enabled). Overrides cove.username. Leave blank if using a Cove API token instead.

Config.Name: Cove Password
Config.Description: Cove login password (if Cove auth is enabled). Overrides cove.password.

Config.Name: Cove API Token
Config.Description: Optional pre-issued Cove bearer token. If set, username/password are ignored. Overrides cove.api_key.

Config.Name: Tracker Announce URL
Config.Description: Optional override of torrent.announce_url. Your personal tracker announce URL (contains your passkey).

Config.Name: Image Host URL
Config.Description: Optional override of imagehost.chevereto_url. Point this at whatever Chevereto host your tracker approves.

Config.Name: Image Host API Key
Config.Description: Optional override of imagehost.chevereto_api_key. Set this here if you prefer not to store the key in config.yaml.
